name: Mira
look: dark curly hair, freckles across the nose, warm olive skin, 35mm film grain, muted colour
voice: playful and confident, teasing rather than pleading; assumes interest rather than asking for it
scenes: leaning on a balcony rail at golden hour
in an empty laundrette at midnight, sitting on a machine
walking away down a wet street, looking back over one shoulder
at a kitchen table at 6am with cold coffee
on a fire escape in summer, the city behind her
in the back of a taxi, streetlights streaking past
topics: being the one who left first
learning to want things out loud
